Title: Realism
Description: Realism holds that the world has a stable structure that exists independently of human observation or interpretation. Reality is 'out there' waiting to be discovered through systematic investigation.
Alignment / Synergy: Compatible Epistemologies: Positivism, Objectivism, Pragmatist | Incompatible: Aesthetic Epistemology
Scoring Information: Gameplay Effect: +2 points if your stack includes a Method with Reproducibility 8 or higher

Title: Constructivism
Description: Constructivism sees reality as something people actively build together through conversation, symbols, shared practices, and social interaction. What we call 'reality' is socially constructed.
Alignment / Synergy: Compatible Epistemologies: Interpretivism, Constructivist Epistemology, Feminist Epistemology, Embodied Epistemology, Aesthetic Epistemology, Critical Epistemology, Pragmatist | Incompatible: Objectivism
Scoring Information: Gameplay Effect: When you complete a stack containing at least 2 Methods with Sensibility 7+, draw 1 card (then discard to 7)

Title: Interpretivism
Description: Knowledge comes from understanding how people interpret and make meaning of their worlds. Emphasizes depth, context, and subjective experience over generalization.
Alignment / Synergy: Compatible Ontologies: Relativism, Constructivism | Synergy Methods: Interview (Qualitative), Case Study, Ethnography, Textual Analysis, Oral History, Biographical Method, Thematic Analysis
Scoring Information: SCORING: Compatible Ontology + Synergy Method = +10 pts (Coherent Paradigm) | Incompatible Ontology = -5 pts | Neither = +3 pts (Mixed Paradigm)

Title: Positivism
Description: Knowledge is produced through empirical observation, measurement, and testing. Reality can be objectively known through the scientific method and value-free inquiry.
Alignment / Synergy: Compatible Ontologies: Realism | Incompatible Ontologies: Relativism, Constructivism | Synergy Methods: Survey (Quantitative), Experimental Design, Statistical Analysis, Content Analysis, Social Media Mining, Archival Research, Corpus Linguistics
Scoring Information: SCORING: Compatible Ontology + Synergy Method = +10 pts (Coherent Paradigm) | Incompatible Ontology = -5 pts | Neither = +3 pts (Mixed Paradigm)

Title: Hermeneutics
Description: The art and science of interpretation, originally of religious texts, now applied broadly. Emphasizes the hermeneutic circle: we understand parts through the whole and the whole through its parts.
Scoring Information: +7 points if aligned with stack's Epistemology | 0 points if not aligned | (Highly Specialized: 1 alignment)

Title: Phenomenology
Description: Philosophical approach exploring how consciousness experiences phenomena. Bracketing assumptions to understand the essential structures of lived experience.
Scoring Information: +5 points if aligned with stack's Epistemology | 0 points if not aligned | (Standard Focus: 2 alignments)

Title: Postcolonial Theory
Description: Critical framework examining the lasting impacts of colonialism on culture, literature, and power relations. Centers voices and perspectives marginalized by colonial history.
Alignment / Synergy: Aligns with: Critical Epistemology, Feminist Epistemology, Interpretivism
Scoring Information: +3 points if aligned with stack's Epistemology | 0 points if not aligned | (Broad/Flexible: 3 alignments)

Title: Ethnography
Description: Immersive fieldwork where the researcher participates in and observes a community or culture over time. Produces rich, contextual understanding of social practices.
Scoring Information: If Ethical Risk ≥7: -1 pt | Contributes to Objectivity Award (sum Reproducibility) | Contributes to Insight Award (sum Sensibility) | If avg Novelty ≥7: +3 pts Cutting-Edge Bonus

Title: Interview (Qualitative)
Description: In-depth, semi-structured conversations with participants to explore their experiences, perspectives, and meanings. Data is analyzed thematically or narratively.
Scoring Information: Contributes to Objectivity Award (sum Reproducibility) | Contributes to Insight Award (sum Sensibility) | If avg Novelty ≥7: +3 pts Cutting-Edge Bonus

Title: Statistical Analysis
Description: Mathematical techniques for analyzing numerical data, identifying patterns, and testing hypotheses. Includes regression, correlation, and significance testing.
Scoring Information: Contributes to Objectivity Award (sum Reproducibility) | Contributes to Insight Award (sum Sensibility) | Methodological Extreme: Sensibility ≤2, discard 1 extra card to play

Title: Autoethnography
Description: A reflexive research method where the researcher uses their own lived experience as primary data to explore cultural phenomena. Combines autobiography and ethnography.
Scoring Information: If Ethical Risk ≥7: -1 pt | Contributes to Insight Award (sum Sensibility) | If avg Novelty ≥7: +3 pts Cutting-Edge Bonus | Methodological Extreme: Reproducibility ≤2, discard 1 extra card to play

Title: Corpus Linguistics
Description: Computer-aided analysis of large text collections (corpora) to study language patterns, frequencies, and usage. Combines computational and linguistic methods.
Scoring Information: Contributes to Objectivity Award (sum Reproducibility) | Contributes to Insight Award (sum Sensibility) | If avg Novelty ≥7: +3 pts Cutting-Edge Bonus

Title: Digital Media & Online Communities
Description: Research into how people interact on the internet, including social media, forums, gaming, and virtual worlds.
Scoring Information: +2 points if any card in your stack shares a keyword with this Object-of-Study (max +2 total)

Title: Memory & Oral Histories
Description: Focuses on how memories are constructed, preserved, and passed down through personal testimony and collective remembering.
Scoring Information: +2 points if any card in your stack shares a keyword with this Object-of-Study (max +2 total)

Title: Major Breakthrough
Description: Choose one of your incomplete research stacks. Immediately score it as a Coherent Paradigm (+10 points), ignoring any incompatibilities or minimum Method requirements.
Scoring Information: Powerful effect - use strategically when you have an incompatible stack!

Title: Funding Boost
Description: Draw 2 cards from the draw pile (then discard to return to 7-card hand).

Title: Ethical Committee Revision
Description: Add +2 Ethical Risk to one Method card in any player's stack (including your own).
Scoring Information: Can trigger -1 point penalty if it pushes a Method to 7+ Ethical Risk
